title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Integrated Nutrition, Health and Food Security and Livelihood programme is implemented by Trócaire in Tobo, Heiban and Dellami counties, aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: Individuals and communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief towards independence. The activities and objective include women in households that have attended nutrition services are trained and supported alternative livelihood options which are more sustainable and climate resilient and provide resources (seeds, tools and grants) to enable recovery of livelihoods so those affected by crisis can protect, revitalise and restore their livelihoods. Programmes are in partnership with, Bishop Gassis Relief and Rescue Foundation (BGRRF) ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Promote sustainable, resilient approaches to agriculture i.e. the adoption of agroecological practices- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- reduce poverty at a household level for the most marginalised of a community- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Building resilience to climate change involves applying strategies that are directly related to climate adaptation - agroecology, protecting natural resources and poverty reduction are part of this as they support individuals, households and communities to adapt to climate change impacts so they are better able to cope.
